quotes.text: I’m fighting to ensure the United States remains the pro-innovation capital of the world. America’s economic leadership in the 21st century will be defined by innovation. From artificial intelligence to advanced manufacturing to next-generation financial technologies, the future should be built here in Maryland, creating good-paying jobs, strengthening our communities, and ensuring the United States remains competitive in a rapidly changing economy.
Innovation must work for everyone. New technologies should expand opportunity, strengthen our economy, and protect consumers and communities, not concentrate power in the hands of a few corporations.

Invest aggressively in emerging technologies including clean energy, artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing, and biotechnology so Maryland and the United States stay ahead of global competitors and create the next generation of good paying jobs.

Support responsible investment in data centers and advanced technology infrastructure that creates jobs and economic growth while ensuring companies pay their fair share, use renewable energy, and incorporate community input in development decisions.
